dz: 根据爱德华·吉本(Edward Gibbon)的说法,奥斯曼一世第一次入侵了尼可米地的领土,通常被认为是奥斯曼国的开国日.
de: According to Edward Gibbon, Osman I invades the territory of Nicomedia for the first time, usually considered to be the founding day of the Ottoman state.

dz: 伊克汗国统治者加赞在霍姆斯附近的Wadi al-Khaznadar战役中击败了一支反对他入侵叙利亚的马姆卢克军队.
de: The Ilkhanate ruler Ghazan defeats a Mamluk army that opposes his invasion into Syria in the Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar near Homs.
